news.headline: IDBI Bank shares fall 7% as investors book profit after Fairfax deal gets cabinet nod
news.summary: IDBI Bank shares plunged as investors booked profits after a nearly 13% rally in the previous session following the Cabinet’s approval of Fairfax’s acquisition of a 60.72% stake in the lender. The stock had hit Rs 93.60 on Wednesday, lifting its market capitalisation above Rs 1 lakh crore. The Rs 52,878 crore deal marks a major step in IDBI Bank’s long-awaited privatisation, with Fairfax’s bid of Rs 81 per share exceeding the independent valuers’ average fair value of Rs 75.99.

news.headline: Reliance Jio IPO at Rs 10 lakh crore valuation: What analysts see in the price band
news.summary: Reliance Jio has announced its IPO price range, setting it between Rs 1,065 and Rs 1,119 per share. With a massive valuation of around Rs 10.3 lakh crore, this IPO stands as the largest in Indian history. While analysts believe the valuation is reasonable, they warn that anticipated growth may already be priced in.

news.headline: Reliance Industries shares rise 3% as Jio sets price band for possibly biggest-ever issue. What shareholders must know
news.summary: Shares of Reliance Industries rose 3% after Jio Platforms announced its IPO, comprising 27 crore new shares anticipated to garner Rs 30,213 crore. With 35% of shares earmarked for retail investors and a cut-off date of October 14 for current shareholders, Jio Platforms is primed to enhance its foothold in the consumer tech and digital infrastructure sectors.

news.headline: Indian bonds breathe easy as Treasury yields decline
news.summary: Early Thursday, bonds issued by the Indian government saw slight upswings, influenced by a rally in US Treasuries. Despite this, concerns over liquidity, climbing interest rates, and mounting supply challenges have capped these hikes. Traders are curbing risk levels prior to a major debt auction, while rising domestic inflation fuels anticipations of a tougher monetary approach from the Reserve Bank of India, as evidenced by the expanding India-U.S. yield spread.

news.headline: From Rs 1,000 in 1977 to Rs 52 lakh today: The Reliance wealth story behind Jio’s Rs 10.3 lakh crore mega IPO
news.summary: A Rs 1,000 investment in Reliance Industries’ 1977 IPO could be worth nearly Rs 52 lakh today, including shares received through the Jio Financial Services demerger. As Jio Platforms prepares for its Rs 30,200 crore IPO at a Rs 10.3 lakh crore valuation, investors will assess its growth prospects and pricing.

news.headline: Global Market: Bank of China (Hong Kong) plans $3.3 billion onshore yuan debt issuance
news.summary: Bank of China (Hong Kong) plans to issue up to 22.2 billion yuan in onshore negotiable certificates of deposit in 2026, strengthening funding access and financial integration. The move supports Hong Kong’s ambition to become a leading offshore yuan hub, promoting cross-border investment and expanding the Chinese currency’s international role.

news.headline: HDFC Bank Share Price Live Updates: HDFC Bank Surpasses Key Resistance Level
Canara Bank shares slide over 6% after Q2 earnings. Buy, sell or hold the state lender?
news.summary: Canara Bank shares fell sharply on Thursday despite reporting an 8% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 standalone net profit to Rs 5,175 crore. Brokerages remain divided, with Morgan Stanley retaining an Underweight rating, while Motilal Oswal and JM Financial recommend buying the stock.

news.headline: Global Market: TSMC set for sixth straight record quarterly profit on AI chip boom
news.summary: TSMC is expected to report its sixth consecutive quarter of record earnings, driven by surging AI chip demand and technology investments. Analysts forecast a 65% profit increase, while investors await updated guidance amid interest-rate concerns and expanding global manufacturing plans, including major US investments to strengthen semiconductor production capacity.

news.headline: BHEL shares fall 4% despite Q2 profit jumping 119% YoY. Should you buy, sell or hold?
news.summary: BHEL shares fell 4.3% after rallying on strong Q2FY27 results, even as Nuvama and JM Financial retained their Buy ratings and raised target prices. Brokerages cited margin expansion, improved execution, a healthy order book and favourable thermal power prospects.

news.headline: Global Market: IMF warns of energy shock, AI correction risks to Asia's growth outlook
news.summary: The IMF warned that Asia’s economic growth may slow to 4.4% in 2027 amid energy price shocks, Middle East conflict, AI market correction risks and rising bond yields. It urged central banks to prioritise price stability and governments to provide targeted fiscal support while managing inflation and debt pressures.

news.headline: 8 Nifty stocks delivered negative returns over 5 years. Do you own any?
news.summary: Over the past five years, eight Nifty stocks have recorded disappointing returns, causing significant impacts on investors' portfolios. Notably, Infosys and TCS saw steep declines of approximately 37% and 36%, respectively. Hindustan Unilever and Asian Paints also struggled, facing losses around 28% and nearly 29%. Other affected companies included HDFC Life and Reliance Industries with negative returns of 22% and 13%. With changing market conditions, investors must re-evaluate their strategies.

news.headline: Global Market: China stocks fall as hot US inflation data revives rate hike fears
news.summary: Chinese stocks tumbled as hotter-than-expected US inflation data revived concerns over prolonged high interest rates. Technology shares led losses across mainland China and Hong Kong markets as investors reassessed the outlook for US monetary policy and risk-sensitive assets.

news.headline: Race for Jio IPO bidding: Can you buy RIL shares now to access Rs 2,500 crore shareholder quota?
news.summary: Reliance Jio has fixed a record date of October 14, 2026, for eligible shareholders of Reliance Industries. This date will determine who can apply for the reserved shares under the shareholder quota. The IPO aims to raise approximately Rs 30,213 crore through fresh equity shares. Eligible investors must apply under the normal IPO process and select the shareholder category.

news.headline: HD Fire Protect IPO Day 3: GMP at 33%, Day 2 subscription hits 16.5 times; check key details
news.summary: HD Fire Protect IPO entered its third and final day of subscription on October 15, 2026. The Rs 712.31-crore offer for sale issue was subscribed 16.50 times on Day 2, led by strong retail and NII demand. The price band is Rs 258-271 with a 33% GMP.
